factor_correction_semantics: replace_step: suppress every product event on effective_date and insert one step with target_ratio; suppress_step: suppress product events on effective_date. The target ratio is derived from the frozen reference factor (type7/type0) and verified against open/high/low/close; max_field_dev records the worst field deviation. Corrections are applied after the canonical event chain, before chain_factors.
raw_correction_semantics: Per-field historical value from the frozen reference type0 bar. Applied to the displayed candle only, after factor computation; corporate events are never rewritten by raw corrections.
usage: Derived factor steps and sparse per-field corrections only; the raw reference series is not redistributed. Source is the owner-authenticated frozen Rahavard snapshot.
